verdict.rationale: Data export and portability is a fair question for an email-delivery SaaS, but the evidence pack has no documented feature for exporting all account data in open formats. Real-time event webhooks, general APIs and SDKs, and logs are building blocks or adjacent features, not a documented export-and-leave capability.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can export all of my data in open formats and leave
